FunctionInput_shopvox_updatesalesorder.description: Identify a sales order and supply only the header and address values to change.

dueDate.description: Saved due calendar date, or null.

txnDate.description: Saved transaction calendar date, or null.

balanceInDollars.description: Saved balance in US dollars, or null.

totalPriceWithTaxInDollars.description: Recomputed total including tax in US dollars, or null.

FunctionOutput_shopvox_updatesalesorder.description: Saved sales-order identity and available header and financial values.

tags.instructions: Get salesOrderId from `list-sales-orders` or `get-sales-order`. Send only header fields to change; omitted values are preserved. For an address, send the components to change and the tool preserves other writable components. Null clearing is not supported; empty text requests empty text. This tool cannot edit lines or attach signatures; use `attach-sales-order-signature` for the latter.

functions.name: verify-connection
functions.description: Check that the connected ShopVox account responds and identify its user and business.

FunctionInput_shopvox_verifyconnection.description: Verify the existing connection without additional input.

status.description: Provider verification status, such as ok; preserved without inventing other states.

accountName.description: Business name of the connected account.

FunctionOutput_shopvox_verifyconnection.description: Verification status and identity reported by the connected ShopVox account.

tags.instructions: Use this to check the current connection and account identity before troubleshooting account access. It does not test access to every business endpoint or plan feature.
